# Bug Catalog: `verify/combat_quick_read.gd`

**Generated by the `design-tests` workflow on 2026-09-21**  
**Scope:** result-first move choices, contextual move explanations, and
all-target stat previews in `game/battle.gd`, `game/tooltip_button.gd`,
`content/combat_moves.gd`, and `content/tutorial_content.gd`.

## Player contract

Combat should be skimmable before it is studied. A move choice must show its
current result in ordinary numbers, while its explanation is available on the
move without requiring a separate formula-only menu. Hovering an all-target
move must preview every target it will affect, not an arbitrary first enemy.
Nothing in this slice changes Glassgoat's move calculations, roster, status
durations, or balance; it explains the current rules as they exist.

## Public interface and seams

| Symbol | Type | Why this is the contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CombatMoves.resolved_hint(stats, move)` | pure display helper | Produces the resolved Quick Read text from the same move data and current actor stats. |
| `Battle._populate_move_menu(actor)` | UI boundary | Builds the actual player-visible move choices. |
| `Button.tooltip_text` / `TooltipButton._make_custom_tooltip()` | contextual-detail boundary | Holds supplemental explanation without adding a second move-menu mode. |
| `Battle._show_all_stat_preview(move, targets)` | preview boundary | Represents every target of an all-target move before commitment. |
| `CombatRules.resolve()` | source-of-truth rule | Defines behavior Quick Read may describe but must not alter. |

## IO boundaries and branching points examined

- **Scene/UI lifecycle:** moving from the main menu to a move list, rebuilding
  choices after actor stats change, tooltip construction, and preview cleanup.
- **Input:** mouse hover exposes context; default visible copy remains enough
  to select a move without hover or a formula toggle.
- **Rule variants:** formula move versus legacy move, damaging move versus
  status-only move, persistent Bleed versus timed status, single target versus
  all target.
- **No persistence/network/randomness:** this slice only reads combat state;
  it must not mutate stats or save data.

## Existing coverage consulted

- `verify/glassgoat_discord_followup.gd` establishes result-first resolved
  numbers and semantic feedback colors. Its old formula-toggle assertion is
  intentionally superseded here: the same explanatory value moves onto each
  move's contextual detail instead of creating a second menu state.
- `verify/combat_feedback.gd` proves target stats and all-foe selection exist,
  but not that every target is previewed.
- `verify/guardian_webcheck.mjs` previously exercised formula-mode toggling;
  it must become a Quick Read/tooltip visual check in this slice.

## Test strategy

`verify/combat_quick_read.gd` constructs the real `Battle` UI, opens a real
Scuba move menu, changes current Strength, and asserts the visible Quick Read
tracks that state. It requires contextual detail on the same button and no
formula-mode control. It then supplies a two-enemy target set to the public
all-target preview seam, checks exactly one additional stat card appears, and
checks cleanup removes it.

### Self-critique

- **Could this pass while the player sees wrong output?** No: it asserts real
  button text/tooltip text built from live `CombatantStats`, rather than a
  separate mock or copied string.
- **Could it fail after a harmless refactor?** Not for the behavior it owns:
  it checks named player concepts (move button, contextual detail, every target)
  rather than child indices or pixels. The all-target helper is a deliberate
  public test seam because it defines the multi-target preview contract.
- **Could it miss rule drift?** It does not re-prove every `CombatRules`
  calculation; Slice 5 owns full formula reconciliation. It does catch the
  display-to-current-rule divide most likely in this UI port: persistent Bleed.

## Skipped

- Pixel-perfect tooltip placement and animation timing — covered by the
  browser/manual evidence requirement, not brittle headless geometry.
- Keyboard tooltip focus behavior — Godot's native tooltip trigger is
  pointer-based. The normal Quick Read must remain sufficient for a
  keyboard-only selection; full combat help remains part of Slice 3.
- Changing status duration, Flash Blast's self-cost, damage, or balance —
  those are explicitly Slice 5 decisions and are prohibited here.

## Post-write evaluation

The red run failed exactly for QUICK-READ-1, QUICK-READ-2, and QUICK-READ-4;
the absent all-target helper logged a script error before the baseline could
reach its remaining assertions. The green run proves the real Battle UI now
has one resolved state, wrapped contextual detail, actor-scaled values,
current persistent/timed-Bleed wording, all-target extra panels, support-move
targeting, and cleanup. The existing Glassgoat follow-up and combat-feedback
contracts remain green.

QUICK-READ-7 first failed because the live target preview exposed no semantic
label. The fix adds `Quick Read — Benefit/Opening/Cost` text from the same
actor-scaled preview data as the colored stat rows. The focused UI contract
and the 1280×720/1920×1080 layout contract are green; a desaturated hosted
capture remains required before the public build is called merge-ready.
